notes.title: 13th Anniversary Patch
notes.notes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[i][b][u]13th Anniversary event[/u][/b][/i]
The following items are available from the Scavenger Hunt: Sapphire, Amethyst, Ruby, Citrine, Diamond Butterfly Wings, Hecate [Ancient] and Birthday Cake.

Find the roaming "The Sword In The Stone" for a chance to get one of the following weapons: Joyeuse, Durendal or The Excalibur.

13th Anniversary decorations can be crafted on your island during the event (Use the Rotate to change the look).

You will receive 1 Lucky Ticket for every 500 MOS purchased.
[spoiler]Lucky Tickets have the potential to contain coins, MOS, and items from previous Anniversary events until the next event; after that, their contents are updated.
List of items from lucky tickets: Orb Of Luck, Stone Of Evolution, Fire Blast Medallion, Water Blast Medallion, Firelord Boots,
High Weapon Enchant, High Armor Enchant, High Jewelry Enchant, High Wings Enchant, Medium Weapon Enchant, Medium Armor Enchant, Medium Jewelry Enchant, Medium Wings Echnant, Superior Weapon Enchant, Superior Armor Enchant, Superior Jewelry Enchant, Superior Wings Enchant, Island Deed, Nephilim Book, Poseidon's Permission, Pluto's Permission, Repeat Quest Permission, Good Present, Great Present, Best Present, Minigame Scroll, Secret Boss Scroll, Demonic Crystal, Warrior Trophy, Superior Satan Potion, Air, Flash, Earth, Water, Fire Altar Permission, Birthday Cake, Party Hat Blue, Red, Green, Purple, Yellow, Teal, White, Black, Pink, Orange, Balloons (Red-Pink), Seraph [Ancient], Baby Sloth, Pinata, Fish Tank, Baby Sea Turtle, Firework Seed, Hammock, different color Combat Capes, Tadpole [Ancient], Sun Hat, Beach Towel, Ice Cream, Magician Bag, Gray Pyjama Costume Box, Orange Pyjama Costume Box, Blue Pyjama Costume Box, Crown Shield, Medusa Wig, Calico Kitten [Legendary], Tuxedo Kitten [Legendary], Orange Tabby Kitten [Legendary], Siamese Kitten [Legendary], Owl Costume Box, Snail [Legendary], Blade of Havoc +1, Hummingbird Statue, Blue Bucket, Sun Parasol, Snorkel Mask, Large Bucket Of Sand, Baby Pelican [Legendary], Fledgling [Legendary], Water Cape, Hummingbird Statue, Sea Animal Statue, Strawberry Costume Box, Apple Costume Box, Traditional Folk Costume Box, Apep Outfit Box, Ra Outfit Box, Golden Scarab [Ancient], Undead Cobra [Ancient].[/spoiler]

Enjoy a 20% discount on MOS store prices until the end of the event.

Red Velvet Outfit (animated) will remain available in the MOS store until the end of the event.

Every Man's Land is open!

The event is scheduled to run until July 31st.

[i][b][u]New max combat stat bosses[/u][/b][/i]
combat Stat level 65 and 70 has been added.

[i][b][u]New low level wizards[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Ritual Totems[/u][/b][/i]
Drop teleport crafting items or teleports - potions and scrolls.
There are 3 static altar types and one roaming on, which may appear on various maps (including PvP)

[i][b][u]Kettle interface[/u][/b][/i]
Similar interface to forging

[i][b][u]Alchemy table interface[/u][/b][/i]
Similar interface to forging

[i][b][u]Decorative water tile[/u][/b][/i]
Can be placed on island, dungeon, premium map. Look is determined by the theme of the map.

[i][b][u]Make all keybind[/u][/b][/i]
Depending on the interface it triggers Make all if available or Make

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Combat level balancing to max combat stat Bosses[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Death call potion revamped[/u][/b][/i]
There is no more static Reaper boss which can be hunted.

[i][b][u]Removed Clay from some alchemy recipes[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Moche I Revamp[/u][/b][/i]
Iron moved closer to town.
New monster spots with higher density.
New enemies added.
Contains 2 boss monsters which are stat capped.

[i][b][u]Poseidon's permission additional resources[/u][/b][/i]
New fishing spot without seaweeds added.
Seaweeds added which can be harvested but they may deal damage more often.

[i][b][u]Teleports crafting recipe changes[/u][/b][/i]
Boss heads are taken out from teleport crafting.

[i][b][u]Changes to boss drops which drop teleport materials[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]If no channel selected requires chat to start with / symbol[/u][/b][/i]
Will help against accidental texts to EN channel

[i][b][u]Plant/mushroom is revived and begins to grow again can be blocked using spam filter[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Eat hotkey disabled for most skill boosting items[/u][/b][/i]
It was mostly unwanted behaviour.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Enchanted Christmas longbow missing max damage boost[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Platinum flint bundle should require lvl 60[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Small potion of defense max craft rate is incorrect[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Small potion of faith, rare craft missing 1 exp[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Forging instructor missing NPC ground halo[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Ghost sprite is broken[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Orc Overlord Slayer achievement image fix[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Clicks/touches near top right buttons can sometimes pass through and start movement[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Android overall system zoom can break game interface[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Blood Cape should not be a drop from Rare Present[/u][/b][/i]

[h1]Mod Updates[/h1]

[i][b][u]Name Tags[/u][/b][/i]
Name tags added for NPCs, and Name Tag options added to game Options user interface. Optimizations for player-dense areas.

notes.title: Easter Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9580756/7350711204bdca53c40a63b711d81377195bbd75.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9580756/2e7fbf9c48ac02230ebdc234c677710dfda5c55c.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9580756/28b12ae45a372e87fdf135a1e5dbc1372d7f0ee5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9580756/b134a13c9a36fb87808a786acf07fcec9f67a4e3.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[i][b][u]Easter Event[/u][/b][/i]
Hunter Outfit parts and Easter Hunter [Ancient] pet are available from Scavenger Hunt.

Easter Egg Yolk is a drop from fishing, mining and woodcutting.
Easter Crystals can be found while digging sand.
Monsters drop either Easter Hunter Battleaxe or Easter Pixie [Ancient] pet.
Easter Egg Yolk and Easter Crystals can be used in carpentry.
Eggplant seeds can be bought from Tavern Shopkeeper.
Easter Bunnies and Easter Eggs can be found around maps. Be careful some of them hit back hard!
Players can start the Easter Invasion boss retaliation by using 3 minigame scrolls.

For every 500 MOS purchased 1 Lucky Ticket is given.
[spoiler]Lucky Tickets may contain coins, mos and items from previous Easter events until next event then it changes.
List of items from lucky tickets: Orb Of Luck, Stone Of Evolution, Fire Blast Medallion, Water Blast Medallion, Firelord Boots,
High Weapon Enchant, High Armor Enchant, High Jewelry Enchant, High Wings Enchant, Medium Weapon Enchant, Medium Armor Enchant, Medium Jewelry Enchant, Medium Wings Echnant, Superior Weapon Enchant, Superior Armor Enchant, Superior Jewelry Enchant, Superior Wings Enchant, Island Deed, Nephilim Book, Poseidon's Permission, Pluto's Permission, Repeat Quest Permission, Good Present, Great Present, Best Present, Minigame Scroll, Secret Boss Scroll, Demonic Crystal, Warrior Trophy, Superior Satan Potion, Air, Flash, Earth, Water, Fire Altar Permission, Egg Helmet, Egg Shield, Easter Egg [Legendary], Beaker [Legendary], Giant Bunny, Rabbit Outfit Box, Wild Egg, Rabbit Hunting Longbow, Lamb [Legendary], Kid [Legendary], Cria [Legendary], Easter Wall, Easter Window, Easter Basket Cabinet, Duckling [Legendary], Gosling [Legendary], Egg Statue, Easter Breeding Nest, Easter Chocolate, Easter Floor, Chocolate Bunny, Shiny Egg Costume Box, Eggplant Seed, Pinky [Legendary], Joe [Legendary], Bob [Legendary], Easter Chair, Easter Cabinet, Easter Chest, Easter Table, Easter Gate, Easter Bed, Sharp Carrot, Rabbit Hunter Longbow, Galanthus Wings, Rabbit Ears, Rabbit Balloon, Bee Larva [Legendary], Lamb Outfit Box, Easter Silver Egg Statue, Easter Golden Egg Statue, Easter Bunting, Easter Pet Fence, Silver Wolf Cub [Legendary], Golden Wolf Cub [Legendary], Wolf Shield:, Easter Hat, Easter Crystal Short Sword, Easter Crystal Staff, Easter Crystal Shortbow, Easter Ghost Outfit Box, Easter Spirit Outfit Box, Easter Ghost Shortbow, Easter Spirit Longbow.[/spoiler]

MOS store prices -20% until the end of event.

Red Velvet Outfit (animated) is available from MOS store. Withered Rose Plate Outfit, seasonal Surprise Egg and Surprise Pet Egg will be available until the end of event in the MOS store.

[i][b][u]Monster book drops as a collection book page[/u][/b][/i]
Need to have each drop unlocked for it to appear in the collection book

[i][b][u]Pet level up screen[/u][/b][/i]
Screen is displayed when pets level up

[i][b][u]3 new foods[/u][/b][/i]
They boost skill stats

[i][b][u]Attack animation customization[/u][/b][/i]
Can be accessed if you have premium from Game options -> Attack animation.
Can also choose color of the attack if you have a Paint kit (not consumed).

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Cooking & Alchemy revamp Part 2[/u][/b][/i]
4 tier of stat and healing potions were added
[list]Serum
Brew
Flask
Reinforced Vial[/list]

10+ Potions which focus on healing were added. All pure healing potions have prefix "Elixir"

Potions price formula changes, removed complex custom price calculations and is now unified formula
Rare potions have their own price formula now.

[i][b][u]Refer a friend bonus to 10%[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Combat instructors added at beginner area town/outpost entrances[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Poisonous Behemoth drops behemoth eyes[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]New Kettle dishes have correct prices added[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Dolphin sushi recipe changed[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Some Dishes require less ingredients[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]New potions stat boost formula changed[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Max craft rate for some potions is increased[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Raw material drop rate changes[/u][/b][/i]

Silver dragon scale
orc fang
beast fang
Beast leather
behemoth eye
animal leather
undead eye
frozen leather
ruby horn

Otherwise can mess up the game size

[i][b][u]Paint kit price increase[/u][/b][/i]
From 150 MOS to 200 MOS. Base price from 600k to 800k coins.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Farming foods provide more hp than intended[/u][/b][/i]
Farming edible foods HP recovery will be reduced. New dishes will be provided soon for some higher level farming foods aslo.

[i][b][u]Behemoth eyes drop rate is too low[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Mushroom oil gave too much exp[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Blue Marine Soup gave too little exp[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Flask of archery should use large potion of water[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Elixir of arcane should not use beast eyes[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Salmon soup incorrect cost[/u][/b][/i]
carrot was removed from craft formula but was left at sell price

[i][b][u]Enchanted death blast orb, wrong inventory image[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Unable to cook Sturgeon sushi[/u][/b][/i]
Fir log added to Isinglass formula

[i][b][u]Fixed nature tower diagonal shooting[/u][/b][/i]

raw pike
raw eel
raw oarfish

[i][b][u]Ignore same tag players in pvp[/u][/b][/i]
Can be enabled from danger level screen.
Can choose who can be attacked - all or only other tags
Works on No Man's Land, No Man's Dungeon and Every Man's Land

[i][b][u]Travel to a random island[/u][/b][/i]
Can use the ship on your island to travel to a random player's island.
When asked for a location - leave it empty for a random island.

[i][b][u]Quiver supporting multiple arrows[/u][/b][/i]
Can choose which arrow to shoot

[i][b][u]Double tap on chest slot to withdraw[/u][/b][/i]
Double tapping will withdraw chest items on touch devices

[i][b][u]Distance magic that automatically targets multiple monsters[/u][/b][/i]
Only usable when not in a close combat fight. Only usable on monsters.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Cooking & Alchemy revamp[/u][/b][/i]
To support cooking, alchemy, farming, fungiculture, fishing up to 150 and add different cooking, alchemy recipes
[b]NB: Before going on a journey, please validate your food and evaluate if you have enough quality food as some food HP-s were changed.
[/b]
Main target is for farming, fishing, fungiculture to provide raw materials.
Cooking can create better and high healing foods
Using food types with alchemy, can also create potions which provide health additionally to stats

[b]Example:[/b]
Cooking hammer shark dish provides high health food.
Using food material with Yellow leaves may provide potion which provides strength and health on consumption. Keeping Stat up and also healing.

Some cooking recipes levels were modified.
TBA after patch is launched.
Cause of balancing issues, new alchemy potions were disabled currently, they will be hot-fixed during event.

[i][b][u]Buy items and coins rename[/u][/b][/i]
Will be called "MOS Market"

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Broken captchas[/u][/b][/i]
Sometimes generated captchas displayed an unreadable image.

[i][b][u]Map names and [BOSS] via /find.[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Kill Quest /timer preset was not updating properly.[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Breeding Nest showed as 0 exp in /wiki.[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Could not right-click Whisper or Inspect players with apostrophes in their name.[/u][/b][/i]

[h1]Mod Updates[/h1]

[i][b][u]Added Inspect to action menu in /wiki.[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Changed item tooltip and wiki Arrow Cooldown display to two decimal places.[/u][/b][/i]

Lower the field of view, but increase the size of things on map.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Blood crystal mining exp change[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Old blood giant sword rename[/u][/b][/i]
Old blood giant sword is now "Berserker Giant Sword"

[i][b][u]Pouches and spell books were moved from tool category to Weapon[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Pouches and books price increases with each size upgrade[/u][/b][/i]
Previously price was the same.
Now each size upgrade grants 10% price increase, based on initial item. Therefore book [M] is 20% more expensive than regular one.

[i][b][u]Improvements to flow when password must be resetted[/u][/b][/i]
Instead of saying Wrong password it will redirect to password reset screen

[i][b][u]Display killed by[/u][/b][/i]
It will say who killed you instead of just "You have been killed..."

[i][b][u]Teleport Crystal and Ladder[/u][/b][/i]
Teleport Crystal can be placed in dungeon.
Ladder can be placed on premium map.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Blood crystal does not work with destroy all ores keybind[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Email field not ignoring keybinds[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Wiki mod sorting[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Bone helmet had incorrect price[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Some items had invalid category attached to them[/u][/b][/i]
Ancient Page, Cursed Tome, Medallion Fragment, and Large Fragment are now under Material category

[i][b][u]Player map floor rendering issue[/u][/b][/i]
Everything had an ugly green edge around when not using Dorpat Green theme.
Credits for youhaveavirus for coming up with the initial solution.

[i][b][u]Minimap rendering issues[/u][/b][/i]
Darker maps had some overlay of the previous map


[h1]Mod Updates[/h1]

[i][b][u]Potion effect display at login[/u][/b][/i]
The potion effect will now display the boosted values at login and world change. Uses a placeholder image in place of the original potion image. (Requires the Miscellaneous Improvements mod loaded.)

[i][b][u]Count of active market offers[/u][/b][/i]
Count of "Active / Maximum" market offers displayed at top of Transactions page.
Warning at top of New Offer page if you have no available market offers to post.

[i][b][u]Farming Queue[/u][/b][/i]
Added prompt to confirm clearing of queue.
Queue mode will be set to Paused when entering island to ensure player movement is not blocked.
Minor bug fixes.

[i][b][u]Timer mod[/u][/b][/i]
Adds context menu capability for iOS devices within the /timer GUI.
Minor bug fixes related to timer names.

[i][b][u]/find updates[/u][/b][/i]
Fixed name of Sequoia fishing rod spot [level 122] POI.
Fixed Death Observer POI.
Added /find entries for level 122+ fish.

[i][b][u]Enhanced Item Tooltips[/u][/b][/i]
Can be toggled on/off via Game Options -> Video -> Enhanced tooltips. Enabled by default for non-mobile devices; disable dby default for mobile devices.
Colors items by "rarity" based on level or item value.
Colors text of unmet skill requirements as yellow.
Adds Craft (Breeding), Party Quest, Boss Retaliation, and Rare Key to "Obtained:" details. (Enhanced Tooltips not required)

[i][b][u]Wiki enhancements[/u][/b][/i]
Bug fixes: optimizations, minor display issues, filters with no function, refined search results, and more.
ITEM -> TYPE -> Jewelry replaced by NECKLACE and RING sections (ITEM -> SKILL -> JEWELRY still exists).
MOB -> filters for World Bosses, Cathedral Bosses, Boss Retaliation, and Rares; searchable by mob name or drops.
MOB results can now be sorted by Magic, Melee Block, Magic Block, and Archery Block.
CRAFT section now has clickable (Find) button for locating farming, fishing, mining, and woodcutting objects.
ENCHANT section display changed to align with CRAFT section -- enchanting result displayed in first column.
ENCHANT section: previous enchant step removed due to confusion, and previous enchant step removed from search results to make the table more concise and logical.
SPELLS section: Cost/S changed to Min CD (minimum cooldown).
ARROW -> ALL returns now with functioning range filters and sorting.
PET -> ALL and NAME present as item views, and FAMILY shows the evolution chain (now searchable, and incorrect chains fixed).
BREED -> ALL and NAME now has labels for parents; offspring order changed to match roll order.
BREED -> PARENT now lists insurance costs under PARENTS; search PARENTS by parent name or food name.
Items with multiple crafting formulas now display the correct exp based on the materials for each possible combination.
Right-click -> Check Wiki ITEM from chest interface.
Walkthrough of changes available at https://youtu.be/1-73dStgJ-8

War wings got stat alignment based on regular wings, increasing armor and power.

[i][b][u]Obsidian, Ender gear obtainable[/u][/b][/i]
Ender and obsidian gears (150, 145), can be obtained. Unique sprites added for both gear sets.

125+ forging/wizardry level requirements modified.

120 - 125 = Redemption
125 - 130 = Incarantion
130 - 135 = Feral

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[i][b][u]Skill quests exp rewards scale with required item amount.[/u][/b][/i]
Previously if you took skill quest which required 250 or 500 of the same item, exp reward per item was the same.
Now higher amount awards more exp. Therefore it is more beneficial to take quests which require more items for completion.
It will be applied to base exp calculation, therefore quest quality will multiply that.
[b]NB:[/b] Carpentry is not included into that formula

[i][b][u]New jewelry pricing logic[/u][/b][/i]
As new jewelry is following same "wiki price" rules as armors and weapons, their price is a lot lower.

Abelsonite jewelry crafting requires also Taffeite Shards, which can be found at any Elite chest, Cathedral or bought from Jewelry store.

[i][b][u] [R]Jewelry level wiki requirement correction[/u][/b][/i]
Refined jewelry displays same jewelry requirement as main crafting.
However last testing resolved that removing R equip requirement, may lead to situations, where users equipped jewelry is also consumed in crafting. 

[b]Example[/b]
User has 10 refined sapphire gems at inventory.
Inventory also has enchanted golden ring (main equipment), 
Inventory also has enchanted white golden ring.
User wants to upgrade white gold ring, actually golden ring is consumed, since in code array it's before whit gold.

Therefore that change requires new interface.
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=10905 equip hp level issue remains.

Possible modes: solo, duo, trio (in duo and trio your team is marked with blue, enemies are with red).
In team mode it is possible to revive your team mates if they have been knocked down.

[list]Kombu Seaweed - Requires lvl 20 farming

Palmaria Plant - Requires lvl 95 farming[/list]

Same idea as rare monsters but with bosses and for this new map only.
Successful test means - random boss locations for underwater map, otherwise only static ones like current other maps.

[b]Logic:[/b]
Random spawn boss has 2 drop table rotations..
Rotation A
Rotation B

Rotation A spawns after every N+Y minutes
Rotation B spawns after every N+Y+X minutes

Random boss spawn base time is not related to its HP.

Bosses are alive untill killed or till server maintenance restart. There are no world notifications about boss spawn.

[i][b][u]Remove magic spells and arrows from pouch / quiver[/u][/b][/i]
If you have left less than enough to convert into an item you can now choose to destroy them. Only works when chest is open.

[i][b][u]Content cap upgrade - Part 1[/u][/b][/i]
Skills content support up to level 150.

Following skill will get supported.
Accuracy, strength, health, defense, mining, forging, jewelry, woodcutting, archery, fletching, fishing, cooking.

[b][i]Part 1:[/i][/b]

[b]Mining:[/b]
Edoylerite - located in No man's land dungeon & Wittensten.

[b]Woodcutting:[/b]
Sequoia Tree - Short path is located at No man's land
Sequoia Tree - Long Path is located at Wittenstein.

[b]Jevelry:[/b]
Abelsonite - located in No man's land & Dungeon IV.

Missing:
Some images.
Items added up to lvl 140.
Jewelry is not added yet - Only ore deposit and smelting.
Strength weapons are not added.
Capes/wings are not added yet.
Gloves are not added.
Firelord upgrading is missing.

[i][b][u]Jewelry exp revamp[/u][/b][/i]

Jewelry crafting activities(adding gems, refining etc..) will get passive fail rate exp boost.
Smelting activities won't get passive exp rate boost.

[i]Passive exp rate boost:[/i]
it's included always and scales up with success rate.

[b]Example:[/b]
Currently "Silver sapphire ring" would give 30 exp on success.
With passive exp boost, it will give 45 exp on success.

Legendary	15%
Ancient	25%[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9580756/248036b27a14719eb54bd5d5119217ec9d445c54.png[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[i][b][u]New Boss trophies[/u][/b][/i]
Added following boss trophies:
- Ancient Hydra
- Ogre King
- Cannibal Plant
- Raguel The Archangel
- Acid Dragon Lord
- Emerald God

Added also teleport potions to those bosses.

Ancient Hydra, Acid dragon lord, Raguel the archangel, Monster island cooldown time was changed, cause of trophy items.

[i][b][u]Woodcutting secondary drops[/u][/b][/i]
Golden apple tree seeds may be dropped by Dragon's blood tree.
Growing golden apple trees, require lvl 110 farming.

Maple tree can drop walco soul,
Spirit tree can drop cesis soul,
Blue Palm tree can drop blue leaf seed,
Magic Oak tree can drop blood herb seed,
Void tree can drop Dragon Herb seed, can drop golden tree seed with low %.
Drgon's Blood tree can drop Golden tree seeds.

Walco teleport potion has been added, requires lvl 60 alchemy.


[i][b][u]New skill quests[/u][/b][/i]

Added jewelry bar smelting quests for silver, gold, white gold, platinum, redhodium.
Added Pluto, poseidon, silvanus quests (need to obtain only 1).

[i][b][u]Missing armors[/u][/b][/i]
Changes related to firelord stats may happen, cause of new items.

New items:
Firestone platemail, pants, boots, shield, (forged)
Gilded pants, helmet, enhanced gilded shield, (forged with Azurite bars and golden beaks)
Lucifer helmet, pants, boots, (drop only)
Beelzebub helmet, pants, boots, (drop only)
Emerald Helmet, Emerald full helmet, (forged)
Enchanted Sapphire dragon head,
Enchanted overlord blade,
Enchanted corrupted steel shield.

[b]Changed:[/b]
Gilded platemail can be enchanted like a regular item, not through forging any more.
Gilded shield armor reduced to 72, price reduced to 52000
King's Crown price reduced to 242000.
Landlord crown price reduced to 299480,
Gilded boots price reduced to 36984,
Golden beak price reduced to 8000,
Dragonstone pants require 3 scale instead of 2.
Gilded watering can won't use gold bars any more,
Sapphire halberd requires 74 forging,
Sapphire dragon platemail requires 75 forging,
Fire battle axe requires 89 forging.

[i][b][u]Dismantle jewelry[/u][/b][/i]
Possible to get gems back.
Will be done with gem extractor item.

Refined jewelry moved from anvil to furnace.
Possible to get jewel extractor from jewelry skill quests, boss drops or MOS store.
The more quest points you have, that higher % to get jewel extractor item as reward from jewelry skill quest.

[i][b][u]2x event notifications are sent to our Discord channel[/u][/b][/i]
Join our Discord channel and all 2x events will appear in #2x-alerts
https://discord.gg/RjkWq9Q

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[i][b][u]Create balloon bundles[/u][/b][/i]
3 bundles are added.
Can create a bundle of balloons that are obtained from killing monsters (red, yellow, purple).
Can create a bundle of balloons that are obtained from scavenger hunt (blue, green, pink).
Can create a huge bundle of balloons that are obtained from scavenger hunt & killing monsters (red, yellow, purple, blue, green, pink).

[i][b][u]Duel with custom look[/u][/b][/i]
Players can duel with custom look and pet, warning about custom look is sent to other player.

[i][b][u]Draw loot crates / monsters on top of players[/u][/b][/i]
Other players can no longer hide loot crates or monsters by standing on them.

[i][b][u]Automatic / manual craft on anvil[/u][/b][/i]
Add Make 1 and Make All buttons
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=9630

[i][b][u]Extend Sand tiles around player island[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=9603

[i][b][u]Fletching table last materials[/u][/b][/i]
Fletching table will now remember the last used materials

[i][b][u]Premium running out[/u][/b][/i]
Message is shown in chat on first login when you have less than 3 days of premium left

[i][b][u]Esc key to close on top menu[/u][/b][/i]
Instead of just toggling options it will now close a menu and if no more menus are open it will toggle options

notes.title: 6th Anniversary Event!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9580756/2b01966c47f252c571fa52d4f33fa9218ce8ad36.png[/img]

[u]Happy 6th anniversary![/u]
Balloons, birthday cakes and Seraph pet (24 inventory slot pet) pieces are available for a week in the scavenger hunt. They will appear once every hour on some randomly chosen map, type [u]/event[/u] in chat for information. Different Seraph pet pieces and balloons are available as monster drops. Seraph can be forged on an anvil with 16 pieces (4 heads, 4 legs, 4 bodies, 4 hands) at 25% chance.
[u]MOS store prices -30% for 48 hours.[/u]
Until the end of the event for every [u]500 MOS[/u] purchased [u]1 Lucky Ticket[/u] is given.
Every Man's Land is open for business, find the cow in Dorpat to get there.

[u][u][u]New Features:[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]Death's Dealer npc[/u][/u][/u]
It may sell you a Death's Deal

Each Deal costs 10k coins. It may give you a fragment or Spirit (without upgrades).

[u][u][u]PvP deaths chat filter[/u][/u][/u]
 Hide "yyy was just slain by zzz".

[u][u][u]Can name tombstones[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]Changes:[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]Increase soul fragments drop rate[/u][/u][/u]
Will decrease soul fragment base/wiki price.

[u][u][u]Reduced magic exp gain a bit from spell casting.[/u][/u][/u]
Spells up to level 80, decreased exp -10% per cast.
Over level 81, decreased exp -20% per cast.

[u][u][u]Balance forge exp-s, to make sure, higher level items give better exp[/u][/u][/u]
Current formula is just a Bar == fixed exp. 
That causes problems, where some items have higher craft %, but require same amount of bars.
Impacted skills.
Fletching, Forging, Wizardry because they use same material table.

[u]NB: Will reorder also forging item levels.
NB: Will affect forging success %.
NB: Will affect forging item base prices!![/u]

[u][u]Changed:[/u][/u]
[list][u][u]Forging : [/u][/u]
All bronze items success rate is now 100%.
All bone items success rate is now 95%.
All iron items success rate is now 85%.
All emerald items success rate is now 80%.
All steel items success rate is now 70%.
All Sapphire items success rate is now 65%.
All Firestone items success rate is now 60%.
All Dragonstone items success rate is now 50%.
Changed bone gloves material.
Unified gloves enchanting exp with other items.
Forging hammer forging level changed, materials changed, price changed.

[u][u]Wizardry : [/u][/u]
Bronze wand is renamed to fir wand
Wooden staff is renamed into fir staff
Iron Wand/staff are now cactus wand/staff
Warlord Wand is renamed to Amethyst wand
Cursed Wand is renamed to flaming sapphire wand
Zeus Scepter is renamed to flaming emerald wand 
Ancients scepter is renamed to flaming amethyst wand 
Ability to enchant Flaming staffs.

[u][u]Fletching: [/u][/u]
[u]New items for fletching.[/u]
Fir Stick, Cactus stick, Oak stick, Maple stick, Spirit stick, Blue Palm stick, Magic Oak stick, Void stick
They are required for wizardry staff/wands crafting.

[u]Possible to craft following wands/staffs with wizardry:[/u]
Wooden wand, Wooden staff, Cactus Wand, Cactus Staff, Sapphire Wand, Sapphire staff, Emerald Wand, Emerald staff,
Ruby Wand, Ruby Staff, Amethyst Wand, Amethyst staff, Flaming sapphire Wand, Flaming sapphire staff, Flaming emerald Wand,
Flaming emerald staff, Flaming ruby staff, Flaming amethyst Wand, Flaming amethyst staff, Scepter of Darkness,
Staff of Darkness, Spectral Scepter, Spectral Staff, Fate Scepter, Fate staff

All flaming staffs/wands can be enchanted.

[u]Magician items moved under wizardry[/u]
All items that required magic skill are moved under wizardry category under anvil.
Like shiva, demigod etc.. gears.

[u]New wizardry crafting materials[/u]
Crystal dust - Can be bought from store
Small, medium, large crystal ball - Crafted with crystals, requires wizardry.

[u]Increased material used exp at anvil:[/u]
Spirit log, Blue Palm log, Magic Oak log, Void log, Dragon's Blood log, all jewels, Steel bar, Azurite bar, Fire stone bar, Dragonstone bar.
Bones, Human bones, Beast bones, dwarf bones, a skull, All horns and scales (except golden dragon and unicorn)
[/list]
[u][u][u]Change in Breeding offspring order[/u][/u][/u]
Currently:
Common -> Rare -> Legendary  -> Ancient .

New Order will is:

Rare->Legendary -> Ancient -> Rare-Ancient eggs ->  Common ->  Common Egg

May cause small changes in overall coin RTP.

[u][u][u]PvP map monsters won't appear any more in party quests.[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]mining Clay, base success % increased[/u][/u][/u]
from 40% to 55%

[u][u][u]Tutorial island changes[/u][/u][/u]
Added extra leather, wizardry armors for tutorial.
Added archery tutorial.
Added information regarding to Cathedral and towers.
Added information regarding to bosses, world events.
Added information regarding to /Find and wiki.
Added information regarding to quests that can't be finished during tutorial ( breeding, farming etc..)
Changed tutorial map.
Added custom Clay, Sand, fir objects with high success %, but with lower exp.


[u][u][u]PvE/ PvP Pets[/u][/u][/u]
Stat changes for pets, to make them more PvE, PvP focused.

Pets PvE/PvP boost starts from hp  requirement 50+.
Where HP requirement will determinate base PvE/PvP block,
Rare, Legendary, Ancient grade will provide additional PvE/PvP block, with 2:1 ratio, PvP vs PvE .
Example, if Legendary pet will give +4 % of PvP block, then at PvE it will be +2%.


[u][u][u]Continuous forging.[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]Clear Broceliande path to Magician.[/u][/u][/u]
Will remove 1 tree.

[u][u][u]Boss Retaliation Time Changes[/u][/u][/u]
Ctulhu 10 minutes
Water Colossus 15 mintues
Earth Titan 20 mintues

[u][u][u]Illusion, Poseidon and Silvanus guilds return you to last visited town[/u][/u][/u]
Can only be used inside towns as well.

[u][u][u]New music for maps[/u][/u][/u]
Dungeon III/IV, Witches I/II, Star of Knowledge/Core have new music

[u][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/u]

[u][u][u]After NPC merge, not possible to buy cactus wood[/u][/u][/u]

[u][u][u]Removing Lvl 65 fishing rod spot[/u][/u][/u]
Iron rod fishing spot is for that.

old names are used for /find.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9580756/6aab5b868471c2bf34579d1376ec28ed02d6c995.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]PvE/PvP combat split[/u][/b][/i]
New PvP specific damage reduction attributes will get added, that work only in PvP fights.
Max cap of those damage reductions is 90%.

Armors after level 80 have some passive PvP damage reduction stats.
To get better PvP reduction stats, need to hunt monsters on a PvP maps and forge Souls, that have extra damage reduction.
You can use only 1 soul at a time (currently).

Armor damage reductions are balanced in a way.
Magician -} Warrior -} Archer -} Magician

Soon there will be NPC (Death Dealer) that offers rng soul rewards for coins.
If new players or skillers want to get into PvP and they have coins to spend, then can try their luck at Npc.

[i][b][u]Skill quest point quests[/u][/b][/i]
Hard quests that take a lot of time, will get turned into SQP quest.
Those quests require some kind of slow activity, but give xN amount of qp than others same level quests.

Slower skill quest requirements are lowered. (carpentry, mining gems.)

[i][b][u]Copy pet look[/u][/b][/i]
Override your current pet look with a pet in breeding nest that has entered zoo mode.

[i][b][u]Pet Kitten[/u][/b][/i]
Buy it at Dorpat pet trader.

[i][b][u]New retaliation bosses [/u][/b][/i]
2 New bosses will get added.

New bosses will be stronger, have more parts to attack and have slightly better drop rates for non-common loot.

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]
[i][b][u]Combine shopkeepers and add general shopkeepers into towns[/u][/b][/i]
Towns have General shopkeepers that buy everything at 8%.

[i][b][u]Unifying item names[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]New Shroom images[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Change monsters spell cast types.[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Automatic mod loading[/u][/b][/i]
For non-mobile browsers

[i][b][u]Display a text indicator on first login when EML is open[/u][/b][/i]
"There is a Secret Cow Level."

[i][b][u]Music and sound effects volume sliders[/u][/b][/i]
Also fixes this: https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=9449

[i][b][u]Cthulhu world boss changes[/u][/b][/i]
Ctulhu costs now 2 Minigame scrolls.
Cthulhu parts are now "class" specialized. Some parts area easier for archer, melee, magic, rather than "balanced" way ..

[i][b][u]Captcha chance when opening bundles[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=9411

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9580756/9a85e9ece188751235ad72b5769ff1a2c94c628b.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Possible to upgrade enchanted books casts amount[/u][/b][/i]
Core of knowledge monsters drop Ancient pages, required to upgrade books cast amount.

[i][b][u]New spell[/u][/b][/i]
Wrath of Destruction.
Requires lvl 120 wizardry to craft.

Altar of destruction is located at No man's land.

[i][b][u]Dungeon Layer for Pvp Map.[/u][/b][/i]
Pvp dungeon has exactly the same map rules as top map.
http://puu.sh/A0vcy.png

[i][b][u]Different bosses at PvP areas[/u][/b][/i]
Emerald god(level 3105)  and Ogre King(level 1602) have been added to the NML map.

[i][b][u]New highscores[/u][/b][/i]
- Unlimited top, has pages now (500 per page)
- Minimum skill of at least 30
- Minimum skill total of at least 100 (This will be unavailable for a few hours until calculations finish)

/find dolphin should give navigation to fishing spot it contains.

Can use with and without raw prefix. /find raw dolphin == /find dolphin.
If multiple spots contain same item, lowest level fishing spot is found.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9580756/0b941634bb2a60d70fc095b94c8cbb5bc0c6ccd7.jpg[/img]

[i][b][u]Revamp of No man's Land map[/u][/b][/i]
[url]https://puu.sh/A0va1.png[/url]

[i][b][u]No Man's land entrance will get moved to Narwa[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Spell damages / exp may change[/u][/b][/i]
Better math for spells.
New crafting exp is based on spell damage.

Most spells base cast time was increased.
Spells damages has been increased except Bolts.
Max cooldown has increased for blasts, missiles, poison rain, blizzard, zeus' rage, meteor storm.

[i][b][u]Lowered World Tree health[/u][/b][/i]
-2000 hp

[i][b][u]Mos store items coin values - part 1[/u][/b][/i]
Mos items coin values will get re-verified and their prices may get changed, based on mos cost.

[i][b][u]Player Islands have 3 soils on start[/u][/b][/i]
New islands will all have 3 soils placed on their island

[i][b][u]Starting arena/trivia will give a reward[/u][/b][/i]
Host gets a reward equivalent to winning an easy kill all party quest.

[i][b][u]Secret boss scrolls no longer give xp[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=9378

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[i][b][u]Potion of oblivion inventory image is incorrect[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Kaolinite clay missing from destroy all through keybindings[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]/find ore won't locate veins[/u][/b][/i]
Veins location will get added under the same find command.
Example:
/find azure will point out veins and ores.

[i][b][u]Some monster island bosses had error in cooldown calculation[/u][/b][/i]
Since cooldown calculations are based on drop rewards. Two bosses had incorrect cooldown

Pharaoh cooldown changed from 550 to 330 min.
Raguel the archangel cooldown changed from 300 to 360 min.

[i][b][u]Was possible to get pluto's permission at illusion guild[/u][/b][/i]

notes.title: Easter Event
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/easter_2018.png[/img]

[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Easter event[/u][/b][/i]
New Easter pet.
Hourly Scavenger hunt where Easter eggs drop and new Easter Pet "Beaker" can be found.
Every Man's Land open - talk to the cow in Dorpat to get there.
MOS store items -25%
1 Lucky Ticket given for every 500 MOS purchased. Lucky ticket contents:
MOS 5-100
Coins: 10k to 100k
Items(equal chances): 
Orb Of Luck, Stone Of Evolution, 2x Potion, Fire Blast Medallion, Water Blast Medallion, Firelord Boots,
High Weapon Enchant, High Armor Enchant, High Jewelry Enchant, High Wings Enchant, Medium Weapon Enchant, Medium Armor Enchant, Medium Jewelry Enchant
Medium Wings Echnant, Superior Weapon Enchant, Superior Armor Enchant, Superior Jewelry Enchant, Superior Wings Enchant, Island Deed, Nephilim Book, Premium Scroll
Poseidon's Permission, Pluto's Permission, Repeat Quest Permission, Good Present, Great Present, Best Present, Minigame Scroll, Secret Boss Scroll
Demonic Crystal, Warrior Trophy, Superior Satan Potion, Air,Flash,Earth,Water,Fire Altar Permission,
Easter: Egg Helmet, Egg Shield, Easter Egg [Legendary], Beaker [Legendary], Giant Bunny, Rabbit Outfit Box, Wild Egg, Rabbit Hunting Longbow



[i][b][u]Boss Hunter[/u][/b][/i]

Build Boss spawn area at your island. Only island owner can attack, even after "Sharing is caring" update.

If you fail to kill the boss, summon is lost. No access to a chest after teleported to boss area.
On death, items are not safe.
If you leave the boss area, you can't get back. Need to use up another summoning chance.

After boss summon, there will be a cooldown(different for bosses) before you can summon next boss. 
Possible to decrease it with a Summoning Scroll.
Summoning a boss itself does not require any items.

Summoning scrolls can be obtained from search party-quest, cathedral or MOS store.
Each Hp range can give you a summoning scrolls, therefore higher hp level gives you more rolls for Scroll.
Each cathedral Elite or Boss enemy can drop Summoning scroll.

Summoning scroll reduces boss spawning time by 60 minutes.

Daily limit depends on Monster Island building level.
[b]Level 1. Monster Island[/b]
1 summoning per day, 2 if you have an active premium.
[b]Level 2. Monster Island[/b]
2 summonings per day, 3 if you have an active premium.

[b]Following bosses can be spawned.[/b]
[list]
Demon Overlord - Cooldown: 50 Min, 

Orc Overlord - Cooldown: 60 Min,

[i][b][u]Boss Hunter[/u][/b][/i]

Build Boss spawn area at your island. Only island owner can attack, even after "Sharing is caring" update.

If you fail to kill the boss, summon is lost. No access to a chest after teleported to boss area.
On death, items are not safe.
If you leave the boss area, you can't get back. Need to use up another summoning chance.

After boss summon, there will be a cooldown(different for bosses) before you can summon next boss. 
Possible to decrease it with a Summoning Scroll.
Summoning a boss itself does not require any items.

Summoning scrolls can be obtained from search party-quest, cathedral or MOS store.
Each Hp range can give you a summoning scrolls, therefore higher hp level gives you more rolls for Scroll.
Each cathedral Elite or Boss enemy can drop Summoning scroll.

Summoning scroll reduces boss spawning time by 60 minutes.

Daily limit depends on Monster Island building level.
[b]Level 1. Monster Island[/b]
1 summoning per day, 2 if you have an active premium.
[b]Level 2. Monster Island[/b]
2 summonings per day, 3 if you have an active premium.

notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo-update-2017-09-19.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Feather cotton plants[/u][/b][/i]
Cotton plants are unlocked at level 20 farming,
After every 20 levels, new cotton plant is unlocked. 
[20,40,60,80,100,120]

Dorpat Farmer is selling Cotton tree seeds
Narwa Farmer is selling Angel, Devil tree seeds
Wandering Farmer is selling Ice, Lightning, Phoenix tree seeds

Cotton tree growth time: 20 minutes.
Angel tree growth time: 28 minutes.
Devil tree growth time: 36 minutes.
Ice tree growth time: 70 minutes.
Lightning tree growth time: 90 minutes.
Phoenix tree growth time: 120 minutes.
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/new-trees.png[/img]

[i][b][u]Alchemy table[/u][/b][/i]

Alchemy table is used, to mix feathers
Crafting a feather requires flint and a cotton.
Cotton is obtained from farming cotton trees, Flint can be gained from smelting jewelry bars with flint mould (silver,gold, white gold etc..).
Better flints give higher success rate for feather alchemy.

[u]Silver flint:[/u]
0.25% to get bundle, 30% feather success.

[u]Gold Flint:[/u]
0.5% to get bundle, 40% feather success.

[u]White gold Flint:[/u]
0.75% to get bundle, 55% feather success.

[u]Platinum Flint:[/u]
1% to get bundle, 75% feather success.

[u]Redhodium Flint:[/u]
1.5% to get bundle, 90% feather success.

[i][b][u]Flints and flint mould[/u][/b][/i]
Flint moulds are required for flint crafting.
Flint moulds can be crafted same way as other moulds.
Requires clay and coal.
Refined kaolinite box requires 4 maple log.

Flints are crafted at forge, Flint mould + Jewelry bar.

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Split up magic combat and crafting.[/u][/b][/i]
New skill - Wizardry
Magic skill exp remains, Wizardry starts from level 1.
Automatic crafting has been added for magician items crafting. If inventory contains enough items.

Magician items crafting in Inventory, requires now Wizardry skill.
Crafting spells at altar, requires now Wizardry skill.

Wizardry achievements.

Adds possibility to add skill quests for Wizardry.


[i][b][u]Change silvanus permission RNG[/u][/b][/i]
Currently woodcutting higher level decreases silvanus permission gather %.
Changed RNG in a way to roll first Silvanus permission, second logs.

notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo-update-2017-09-19.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Feather cotton plants[/u][/b][/i]
Cotton plants are unlocked at level 20 farming,
After every 20 levels, new cotton plant is unlocked. 
[20,40,60,80,100,120]

Dorpat Farmer is selling Cotton tree seeds
Narwa Farmer is selling Angel, Devil tree seeds
Wandering Farmer is selling Ice, Lightning, Phoenix tree seeds

Cotton tree growth time: 20 minutes.
Angel tree growth time: 28 minutes.
Devil tree growth time: 36 minutes.
Ice tree growth time: 70 minutes.
Lightning tree growth time: 90 minutes.
Phoenix tree growth time: 120 minutes.
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/new-trees.png[/img]

[i][b][u]Alchemy table[/u][/b][/i]

Alchemy table is used, to mix feathers
Crafting a feather requires flint and a cotton.
Cotton is obtained from farming cotton trees, Flint can be gained from smelting jewelry bars with flint mould (silver,gold, white gold etc..).
Better flints give higher success rate for feather alchemy.

[u]Silver flint:[/u]
0.25% to get bundle, 30% feather success.

[u]Gold Flint:[/u]
0.5% to get bundle, 40% feather success.

[u]White gold Flint:[/u]
0.75% to get bundle, 55% feather success.

[u]Platinum Flint:[/u]
1% to get bundle, 75% feather success.

[u]Redhodium Flint:[/u]
1.5% to get bundle, 90% feather success.

[i][b][u]Flints and flint mould[/u][/b][/i]
Flint moulds are required for flint crafting.
Flint moulds can be crafted same way as other moulds.
Requires clay and coal.
Refined kaolinite box requires 4 maple log.

Flints are crafted at forge, Flint mould + Jewelry bar.

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Split up magic combat and crafting.[/u][/b][/i]
New skill - Wizardry
Magic skill exp remains, Wizardry starts from level 1.
Automatic crafting has been added for magician items crafting. If inventory contains enough items.

Magician items crafting in Inventory, requires now Wizardry skill.
Crafting spells at altar, requires now Wizardry skill.

Wizardry achievements.

Adds possibility to add skill quests for Wizardry.

Currently woodcutting higher level decreases silvanus permission gather %.
Changed RNG in a way to roll first Silvanus permission, second logs.

notes.title: 5th Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/5years.png[/img]
Happy anniversary!
Party hats and birthday cakes for a week in the scavenger hunt. They will appear once every hour on some randomly chosen map, type [b]/event[/b] in chat for information. Scavenger hunt drop rates are 57% for birthday cake, 28.6% for pink party hat and 14.3% for orange party hat.
Birthday cakes are also available as monster drops.
[b]MOS store prices -30% for 48 hours.[/b]
Until the end of the event for every [b]500 MOS[/b] purchased [b]1 Lucky Ticket[/b] is given.
Every Man's Land is open for business, find the cow in Dorpat to get there.

RPG MO is now 5 years old! We have still a lot of new and exciting features planned that will be released in the next few years so here is a list of larger features that we have planned (in random order):
[list]
[*]New and awesome interface
[*]Island upgrades:
    * Island dungeons
    * Island minigames
[*]PvP events (random block %, increased safe item amounts, speed limits, multicombat, free pvp only gear, etc)
[*]Advanced highscores - searchable, private, monthly tops
[*]Guilds:
    * Guild island (100x100 map)
    * Guild dungeon
    * Guild buildings (different buildings that can be upgraded and have various functions)
    * Guild guards
    * Guild chats
    * Guild wars
[*]Skill trees (gain passive bonuses: speed, armor, aim, power)
[*]Treasure hunting
[*]Improved market with price history[/list]
We are also implementing a lot of smaller features and are actively looking at suggestions topic https://forums.mo.ee/viewforum.php?f=6

[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo-update-2017-07-06.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Allow lower levels in party quest[/u][/b][/i]
Party quest maker can set the lowest level who can join 

[i][b][u]Convert cabinets between stackable and non-stackable[/u][/b][/i]
Stackable has 50% the slots and stacks up to 99 of each item.
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=8549
[img]https://puu.sh/wikTV/b23fbd777a.png[/img]

[i][b][u]Active(promoted), top islands[/u][/b][/i]
Possible to promote your island and others can vote for your island - monthly tops. Ship is needed for this feature.
Can vote 2 times per day.

[i][b][u]Chest right click additions[/u][/b][/i]
Can add new offer from chest with right click

[i][b][u]Cabinet right click additions[/u][/b][/i]
Can withdraw and deposit all

[i][b][u]New captcha system[/u][/b][/i]
New captcha will be made available to all players due to very bad experience with Google captcha lately

[i][b][u]Star of Knowledge map[/u][/b][/i]
Island contains magician NPC-s and new monsters.
[img]https://puu.sh/wu7G7.png[/img]

Magicians sell permissions to have fast access, near element altars.
Altar permissions are permanent, similar to guild deeds.

Altar of Air: 40 magic and 750,000 coins.
Altar of Earth: 50 magic and 1,500,000 coins.
Altar of Water: 70 magic and 3,250,000 coins.
Altar of Fire: 100 magic and 5,500,000 coins.

[i][b][u]Craftable magic pouches[/u][/b][/i]

Items are unequipped after dying in nml pvp or by a monster (Except towers, cathedral and eml).
Item is unequipped after using oblivion potion and your skill is not good enough after that to use the item.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo-eml-event.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Steam and standalone support up to 4k resolution[/u][/b][/i]
May need to change the interface size form video settings to fill up entire screen

[i][b][u]/cooldowns command to show time left for all towers and cathedral at once[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=8074

[i][b][u]PvP event every 2nd week of the month unless there is a bigger event that month[/u][/b][/i]
Every Man's Land is open for business, talk to the cow in Dorpat to get there.

[i][b][u]Playable Piano[/u][/b][/i]
Early prototype, can use the "Cathedral Piano" in your island. Need to have Sound Effects (on). More octaves when you use your keyboard - mouse/touch limited to 1 octave for now. Probably won't work on mobile devices.
You can get Cathedral Piano from Quests -> Achievements -> Rewards

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Revamp of Kill quests[/u][/b][/i]
Kill quest order will be changed.
New kill quests will be added (bosses and regular monsters).
Required Boss kills amount for quest completion is reduced by 50%. 
Some quests may be opened up for old players, who have completed them already with X amount of progression.
If you had done boss quests before then you need to redo them, there are now 65 kill quests total.

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo-update-2017-05-07.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Alchemy support up to level 120[/u][/b][/i]
New variations of potions:

Potions that boost stat "a" , but lower stat "b".
Potions that boost stat "a"-"c", but will give you small damage also.
Potions that boost stat "a" and heal a bit.

There is small % to get a Rare potion when crafting potions.
Therefore overall alchemy success % is increased a bit.
Rare potion has higher stat boost, than regular potion.

[b]New uses for spade:[/b]

Possible to dig at graveyards and swamps to get some alchemy items, like bones or fangs.

[i][b][u]Thorn Bushes[/u][/b][/i]
Bushes may cause damage, when gathering berries for alchemy.
Bushes that cause a lot of damage, have visible thorns.

Gathering materials from bushes, gives farming experience.
[img]https://puu.sh/vHWyk.png[/img]

[b]Blueberry bush[/b] :
Requires level 1 farming
Thorns may cause 1 damage.
Located at Whiland.

[b]Raspberry bush[/b] :
Requires level 25 farming
Thorns may cause 2 damage.
Located at Fellin.

[b]Gooseberry bush[/b] :
Requires level 50 farming
Thorns may cause 3 damage.
Located at Broceliande Forest.

[b]Horsenettle bush[/b] :
Requires level 75 farming
Thorns may cause 5 damage.
Located at Narwa.


[i][b][u]Female image variants for equipment.[/u][/b][/i]
All body armors, pants, helmets change visual image when gender is changed.

[i][b][u]PvP event every 2nd week of the month unless there is a bigger event that month[/u][/b][/i]
Every Man's Land is open for business, talk to the cow in Dorpat to get there.

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Potion changes[/u][/b][/i]
Skill support up to 120, may cause small changes in current potion stats.

[i][b][u]Potion Drop changes[/u][/b][/i]
Some potion stats will be changed, therefore drop rates also.

Nature/ice/Fire towers potion drop rate was decreased.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[i][b][u]Some jewelry items have incorrect default price[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=8385

[i][b][u]Possible to skip floor 39 at Tower of Nature[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=8433

[i][b][u]Inventory right click issue on Mac and Linux[/u][/b][/i]
Right click menu position is sometimes off

[i][b][u]Copy paste issue on Mac Standalone and Steam[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Minimap stays open on map change on Chromebook[/u][/b][/i]

notes.title: Game Patch
notes.notes:
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Implement female armors, proof of concept[/u][/b][/i]
Inventory image will stay the same, equip image changes, depending on gender.

Proof of concept is created and working.
Item types that may change look, depending on gender are, boots, pants, body armor, helmet, capes.
[url]https://puu.sh/uXSY2.mp4[/url]

[i][b][u]More quest Masters added into the world[/u][/b][/i]
All major towns, will get a quest master npc

Added nps into: Narwa, Hell, Heaven, Walco, Brocelindae Forest, Fellin
changed location at: Cesis

[i][b][u]Touch device users can toggle dpad[/u][/b][/i]
If you have a touch device then you can toggle the dpad on and off from the Game options.

[i][b][u]Toggle other player pets[/u][/b][/i]
You can toggle other player pets on and off from the Game options.

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Boss respawn randomizer[/u][/b][/i]
To make bossing more fair respawn time is randomized by +/- 10% each time.

[i][b][u]Skill Quest limitations[/u][/b][/i]
If your quest points are 750 over required points and your skills are double and 30 above minimum requirements then they are no longer in the list.

[i][b][u]Skill Quest amount increased from 9 to 10[/u][/b][/i]
Instead of maximum 9 there are now up to 10 possible quests each hour.

[i][b][u]Change ice tower to 4/4/4/4 layout[/u][/b][/i]
With current 4/2/4/2 layout, some rooms will get crowded and players have to wait to continue.

[i][b][u]Presents cleanup[/u][/b][/i]
Since introducing presents into game, almost 2000 new item have been added.
Will remove cheap shop items and really easily obtained items from presents, like "fir window".

Removed most of carpentry items.
Removed cheap shop items (iron/steel/emerald non enchant items).
Removed low magician items (witch items, small magic pouch etc..)
Removed Regular materials [ bars, plain rings/necklaces ( basic white gold ring etc..)]
and many more.. Around ~160 item.

[i][b][u]Add more decorative objects into maps[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Shop content change[/u][/b][/i]
Shop content has not been changed since launch of RPG MO,
will verify shops and their content, what can be bought and sold.

Changed:
Items count changed, to avoid useless world jumping.
Most sold items count changed to 20.
Most material items count changed to 99

A lot beginner items added into shops. (bronze,iron,steel,emerald).

[i][b][u]Changes related to moon and demonic stones[/u][/b][/i]
Currently it's too hard to get Moon and demonic stones, will modify cathedral drop rate and if possible, Void/dungeon monsters may drop them.

Changed:
Soul trapper, Ancient wyvern, Soul eater, drop moon stones with different rates.
Increased cathedral Demonic crystal drop rate by 0.005% for all Elites.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[i][b][u]Gem cutting sound not played when cutting some uncut jewels[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=8209

[i][b][u]Not possible to craft Oracle items, if your alchemy was under 85 or jewelry under 90[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=8174

[i][b][u]Not possible to withdraw full inventory of ores with single keybind if ore had mining parameter attached[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=8309

[i][b][u]Arena can no longer be started if the maintenance will come before it ends[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Valentine's Event[/u][/b][/i]
Monsters and scavenger hunt drop Feather of Heart and Valentine's Ring. Can craft Valentine's Shortbow and Heart Piercing Arrows.
For every 500 MOS purchased 1 scratch ticket is given. These contain Valentine items from this end previous events.
Every Man's Land is open for business, talk to the cow in Dorpat to get there.
MOS store items -25% till the end of event.

[i][b][u]Skill quests[/u][/b][/i]
Skill quests can be taken at "Quest master"
Located at: Dorpat, Reval, Rakblood, Cesis, Narwa
[img]https://puu.sh/tZXXD.png[/img]

Player can have only 1 active skill quest.

10 quests are shown to player after every quest refresh cycle.
Quests are refreshed automatically after every 60 minutes.
Quests can be manually refreshed also, requires 3x "Repeat Quest Permission"

With each cycle, maximum 2 quest from the same skill are shown. Meaning, maximum with each cycle you can get, 2 fishing, 2 mining etc skill..

Quests may have different grades(Common/ Rare / Legendary).
Grades increase rewards gained from the quest.
How often rare or legendary quests appear, depend on collected "Points".
However each quest has capped %, at which rate that quest may be rare or legenday.

Quests may award you with items,mos,exp or coins.
There is no limit, how many quests you can complete on each day.

Better skill quests are unlocked, based on player quest points value and skill level.
[img]https://puu.sh/u1opa.png[/img]

With first patch, following skill quests support is added.
Fishing
Cooking
Forging (smelting and item forging)
Mining
Woodcutting

[i][b][u]Tool crates[/u][/b][/i]
When new players die and lose their material gathering tools  (pickaxe, fishing rod etc..).
They can smash crates near dorpat to get tools again.

Tool crates have Cool-down (they disappear). 

Tool crates are located in Dorpat dungeon and near Dorpat outpost.
Tool crate can give with 5% rate following items: "Fishing Rod, Chisel, Iron Pickaxe, Woodcutter's Axe, Spade, Forging Hammer"

[i][b][u]New Ore and mould formulas[/u][/b][/i]
Kaolinite clay
Requires 50 mining.

New formulas:
3 Kaolinite clay = Kaolinite ring mould box.
Requires 45 jewelry.

1 Kaolinite clay + 1 tin = Kaolinite necklace mould box.
Requires 50 jewelry.

3 Kaolinite clay + 3 fir log =  Kaolinite mould box [R]
Requires  65 jewelry.

1 Kaolinite clay + 3 oak log = Kaolinite mould box [R]
Requires 70 jewelry.

[R] Stands for Refined.

[i][b][u]Refined Jewels[/u][/b][/i]
Refined Jewels are obtained through enchanting.
Requires cut gem + jewelry enchanting scroll.
Refined jewels end with [R] tag.
[img]https://puu.sh/tOGxZ.png[/img]

[i][b][u]Warning on world change in cath/tower/party quests[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=8056

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Improve Jewelry skill and items[/u][/b][/i]
[u]Enchanted[/u] jewelry can be turned into [u]refined[/u] jewelry at forge, requires refined jewels.
Refined jewelry can be enchanted again and obtains extra melee and magic block %, depending on jewelry level.

[i][b][u]Changed fir and oak log hand slots[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Revamp firelord jewelry[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Tower/cathedral multicombat will be always on blocking mode[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]World map updated[/u][/b][/i]
https://mo.mo.ee/world_map_2017_feb.png
Thank you Dragadorn

[i][b][u]Destroy all right click available without mods[/u][/b][/i]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[i][b][u]Equipping another pet wont always bring up the message about xp loss[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Stat toolbar didnt update when equipping rings, necklaces[/u][/b][/i]

notes.title: 21/11/2016 Game patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/rpgmo_patch_21_11_2016.png[/img]
[b][i]New Features:[/i][/b]

[i][b][u]Pet Eggs[/u][/b][/i]
When breeding fails, will get another chanse for egg RNG.
Eggs will award 100% exp for selected breeding outcome.
Eggs don't have inventory space.

Pet Eggs RNG is added if you breed pets that require level 75 breeding or higher.
Eggs are hatched with : Stone Of Evolutions.

Egg color determinates Pet grade.
Green -> Common
Blue -> Rare
Red -> Legendary
Orange -> Ancient

Eggs return rates are fixed and not increased by breeding level.

[img]http://puu.sh/s6z1u.png[/img]

[i][b][u]New 1 handed sword[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]2-step authentication for accounts[/u][/b][/i]
You can add extra layer of security to your account. Go to Player info -> Security to enable.

[i][b][u]Breeding formulas[/u][/b][/i]
Access from Breeding nest. Can see what pets eat and what are their offspring etc.
[img]https://puu.sh/sl4dD/5839167f9c.png[/img]

[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Can Buy Fir floor and walls from furniture master[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]New War Wings sprites[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Rename gloves enchantment eggs and provide new sprites[/u][/b][/i]
Magic Rune [Grade] now.
[img]http://puu.sh/s0Niy.png[/img]

[i][b][u]Breeding output rates increased and changed for few combinations[/u][/b][/i]
Breeding level requirement lowered for output % rng .

[i][b][u]Add magic damage xp effects for spell crafting, add archery skill xp effects[/u][/b][/i]
https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=7626

[i][b][u]Emerald Warhammer required accuracy[/u][/b][/i]

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/towers_update.png[/img]

[i][b][u]New Battle Towers[/u][/b][/i]

Nature tower contains 44+1 Rooms.
Chat command /nature
[url]http://puu.sh/qvqze.png[/url]

Hard tower contains 65+1 Rooms.
Chat command /ice
[url]http://puu.sh/qvqze.png[/url]

Hell Tower contains 88+1 Rooms.
Chat command /fire
[url]http://puu.sh/qANOs.png[/url]


[i][b][u]Magician Capes[/u][/b][/i]
New parameter is added for spells, Minimal casting time, 
nothing is changed for current spells. Cause min time is calculated on current highest cooldown %.
Capes cooldown % is bonus for higher level spells those which require high cooldown time.

[i][b][u]Open World Fletching[/u][/b][/i]
Moche II has open world Fletching table that every one can use.

[i][b][u]Moche II[/u][/b][/i]
Moche II is connected with Reval and Moche I
[url]http://puu.sh/q8vOj.png[/url]


[i][b][u]Portal To Void[/u][/b][/i]
Void is similar to Heaven and Hell, but Void is high level location.
At Void, there are Rare monsters + Battle towers.
[url]http://puu.sh/q51Io.png[/url]

[i][b][u]Battle Towers[/u][/b][/i]
There will be 3 battle tower.
Normal/ Hard / Hell Difficulity levels.

Towers are for Exp gain only. Monsters in Towers drop food and potions only.
There will be no highscore for towers.
[url]http://puu.sh/q82lv.png[/url]
[img]http://puu.sh/qf8br.png[/img]

[i][b][u]New monsters[/u][/b][/i]
Low Level emerald scale monsters + more bird type monsters for feathers.

Sapphire/Emerald/Ruby Dragon Turtles, Faith/Ice Baby Griffin, Faith/Ice Griffin.
Sand Dragon Worm, Emerald Dragon Worm.

[i][b][u]New Boss [Raguel the archangel] [/u][/b][/i]
Drops also mark of raguel.
Located in Void

[i][b][u]New Potion[/u][/b][/i]
Use Sharp Beaks
Potion of faith(s). Increases magic and defense.
Using same potion images as magic potions. Will get refactored.

[i][b][u]Can use teleport scrolls at Void I[/u][/b][/i]
Near chest

[i][b][u]Private channel owners can set member permissions[/u][/b][/i]
Can add chat moderators, channel member list moderators.



[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]
[i][b][u]Remove Resistances from Battle towers[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Lower Monsters defense stat boost at nature tower[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Add % to get higher level potions from Battle tower monsters[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Completing a tower level will give additional exp reward.[/u][/b][/i]
Each Nature tower room awards fixed 400 exp.
Each Ice Tower Room awards 750-2000 exp.
Each Fire Tower Room awards 1000-3500 exp.

[i][b][u]Nature tower layout change[/u][/b][/i]
[url]http://puu.sh/qvn7P.png[/url]

[i][b][u]Public chat report to anyone with a 100+ level[/u][/b][/i]
People with 4 stats over 70 or 1 stat over 100 can use public chat reporting. Right click on a message to report.



[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

http://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=6841

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
[img]https://mo.mo.ee/towers_update.png[/img]

[i][b][u]New Battle Towers[/u][/b][/i]

Nature tower contains 44+1 Rooms.
Chat command /nature
[url]http://puu.sh/qvqze.png[/url]

Hard tower contains 65+1 Rooms.
Chat command /ice
[url]http://puu.sh/qvqze.png[/url]

Hell Tower contains 88+1 Rooms.
Chat command /fire
[url]http://puu.sh/qANOs.png[/url]


[i][b][u]Magician Capes[/u][/b][/i]
New parameter is added for spells, Minimal casting time, 
nothing is changed for current spells. Cause min time is calculated on current highest cooldown %.
Capes cooldown % is bonus for higher level spells those which require high cooldown time.

[i][b][u]Open World Fletching[/u][/b][/i]
Moche II has open world Fletching table that every one can use.

[i][b][u]Moche II[/u][/b][/i]
Moche II is connected with Reval and Moche I
[url]http://puu.sh/q8vOj.png[/url]


[i][b][u]Portal To Void[/u][/b][/i]
Void is similar to Heaven and Hell, but Void is high level location.
At Void, there are Rare monsters + Battle towers.
[url]http://puu.sh/q51Io.png[/url]

[i][b][u]Battle Towers[/u][/b][/i]
There will be 3 battle tower.
Normal/ Hard / Hell Difficulity levels.

Towers are for Exp gain only. Monsters in Towers drop food and potions only.
There will be no highscore for towers.
[url]http://puu.sh/q82lv.png[/url]
[img]http://puu.sh/qf8br.png[/img]

[i][b][u]New monsters[/u][/b][/i]
Low Level emerald scale monsters + more bird type monsters for feathers.

Sapphire/Emerald/Ruby Dragon Turtles, Faith/Ice Baby Griffin, Faith/Ice Griffin.
Sand Dragon Worm, Emerald Dragon Worm.

[i][b][u]New Boss [Raguel the archangel] [/u][/b][/i]
Drops also mark of raguel.
Located in Void

[i][b][u]New Potion[/u][/b][/i]
Use Sharp Beaks
Potion of faith(s). Increases magic and defense.
Using same potion images as magic potions. Will get refactored.

[i][b][u]Can use teleport scrolls at Void I[/u][/b][/i]
Near chest

[i][b][u]Private channel owners can set member permissions[/u][/b][/i]
Can add chat moderators, channel member list moderators.



[i][b]Changes:[/b][/i]
[i][b][u]Remove Resistances from Battle towers[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Lower Monsters defense stat boost at nature tower[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Add % to get higher level potions from Battle tower monsters[/u][/b][/i]

[i][b][u]Completing a tower level will give additional exp reward.[/u][/b][/i]
Each Nature tower room awards fixed 400 exp.
Each Ice Tower Room awards 750-2000 exp.
Each Fire Tower Room awards 1000-3500 exp.

[i][b][u]Nature tower layout change[/u][/b][/i]
[url]http://puu.sh/qvn7P.png[/url]

[i][b][u]Public chat report to anyone with a 100+ level[/u][/b][/i]
People with 4 stats over 70 or 1 stat over 100 can use public chat reporting. Right click on a message to report.
